name: Smita Ghorpade
conditions: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent with ADLs, walks 250 m unaided, manages light housework.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (negative screen).
falls: No falls in past 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 9 seconds (normal).
medicines: 10 regular; polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria recommended.
mood: PHQ-9 7 (mild depressive symptoms); reports occasional low mood, sleep onset difficulty.
carers: Daughter, Priya, provides weekly support.
goals: "I want to stay active and enjoy time with my grandchildren."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: TSH 2.1 mIU/L (0.4-4.0). Haemoglobin 12.8 g/dL (12-16). Insomnia Severity Index score 8 (moderate). PHQ-9 7. Vitamin B12 340 pg/mL (200-900). Serum potassium 4.3 mmol/L (3.5-5.0). Serum creatinine 92 µmol/L (60-110). NT-proBNP 210 pg/mL (<125 borderline).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent with ADLs, walks 120 m with walker, needs help dressing lower body.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 2/5 (positive screen) – plan for full cognitive assessment (repeat annual).
falls: One fall in last 3 months (kitchen slip); gait slow; timed up-and-go 16 seconds (raised fall risk) – continue exercises, review footwear, consider bedside commode.
medicines: 11 regular (including B12); polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria recommended.
mood: PHQ-9 13 (moderate-severe depressive); reports persistent low mood, fatigue, sleep disturbance.
carers: Daughter, Priya, provides weekly support.
goals: "I wish to feel less sad and have better sleep."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to cardiology for optimisation of HFrEF management and review of uptitration of beta-blocker and ACEi/ARNI. Include recent echocardiogram and NT-proBNP trends.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Cardiology outpatient review: EF stable 38%, NYHA II. Recommend uptitrate bisoprolol to 7.5 mg OD if tolerated, continue sacubitril/valsartan, consider ivabradine if heart rate >70 bpm. No urgent changes needed.
